visualCharacteristics.purpose: product/offer cards with a photo (cut-out, side, full-bleed, small, or video still), linked heading, price line, description, check list and bottom-pinned button

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; cell 1 = image (optional), cell 2 = heading (may be a link), optional price line, text, list, button(s). For `video`, include a link to the video in the body cell

usage: Two/three-up product or service cards. Default and `image`: cut-out photo bleeding above the card. `photo-side`: cut-out photo anchored bottom-right. `video`: video still with play overlay and caption. `article`: article teaser with photo on top. `checklist`: small rounded photo, heading and check list. `checklist-green-image`: dark card with photo and check list.
reuseGuidance: Use for photo-led product/service/article cards. Price-only plan comparisons belong in cards-pricing.
